kernel.name: PlaneMatrix::input_grad
kernel.layout: row-major q; pos/neg dual-rail u64; 1 trit = 2 bit
kernel.fallback: scalar when target_arch != x86_64 or cols < 8 or AVX2 unavailable
not: dW fused update (separate dense::sgd_update path, not part of this dX snapshot)
forward dot is fused::forward_dot in the train-step branch, not part of this dX snapshot
backward dX in training uses fused::backward, not this snapshot's pack+input_grad path

benchmark.timing_scope: kernel-only; pack()/quantization excluded; caller-preallocated out; internal accumulator allocation included

training_step.status: training_step merged at 9d1f0cc6 (#666); fused forward + adam_dw + lazy q + qdot + fused backward PR #668 (open, c64fe0c7)
training_step.operation: train_step: fused::forward_dot quantizes and dots in one pass -> dense::sgd_update(dW) -> scale update from qdot; forward(): fused::forward_dot -> scale; train_step_with_grad: fused::backward -> dense::sgd_update(dW) -> scale update from qdot; adam: fused::backward -> layer::adam_update(dW) -> scale update from qdot; pack() is public inspection/comparison only

benchmark.timing_scope: end-to-end SGD train_step: fused quantize-dot forward + qdot reuse + dW + scale update; pack() excluded; q() lazy decode, layer construction and input generation excluded; release binary run directly
benchmark.pack_note: reference only; training/forward paths no longer call pack()

fused_forward.implementation: clamp(round(w/scale),-1,1) + sign-mask dot in one pass; same j mod 4 grouping and hsum as row_dot
fused_forward.note: SGD train_step 与 forward() 不再构造 pos/neg 双导轨；training uses fused::backward

fused_backward.implementation: one quantize pass produces 3 q masks; dX uses 4 accumulators grouped by r & 3; qdot uses 4 accumulators grouped by j mod 4; scalar tail matches input_grad order
fused_backward.note: train_step_with_grad 与 Adam 都不再 pack()；pack() 只保留公开检查/对拍

row_dot.accumulation_order: j mod 4 unchanged; bit-identical to the dynamic-index version
row_dot.note: 整步 A/B 是同轮交替的安静样本；row_dot 现在只服务 pack() 消费方与标量对拍

not: bit-plane dW (dW is fused outer-product, not dual-rail)
bit-plane Adam update (Adam dW is row-fused, not dual-rail)
multi-layer end-to-end throughput (single-layer multi-shape matrix exists)

limits: 本快照的 benchmark 只覆盖 dX = Wᵀdy；训练步读数见 training_step，两者不能互相替代。
dX 读数只覆盖 4096×576、单线程；不含 pack() 的量化成本。
训练步是单层单样本的端到端口径（SGD/Adam 都不含 pack，不含 q() 惰性解码），不含层构造/输入生成。

train_step 的 SGD 前向走 plane::fused::forward_dot（量化+点积一遍，不构造双导轨）、SGD dW 走 dense::sgd_update；forward() 也走 fused；train_step_with_grad 与 Adam 走 plane::fused::backward（量化 + dX + qdot 一遍，不 pack）；Adam 路径没有前向、不复用 qdot；Adam dW 走 layer::adam_update（行级融合，非位平面）；pack() 只保留公开检查/对拍。
multi_shape 是单层、单样本的 SGD/Adam 矩阵；9x65 的绝对耗时只有 0.2–0.4 µs，倍数会抖，1x1 不计入证据。
row_dot 独立探针只测 4096 行、单线程；整步 A/B 是负载噪声下的同轮交替安静样本，不是 25 轮统计。
非 x86_64 或 cols < 8 自动回退标量；没有跨平台性能结论。
q() 首次调用才从双导轨解码并缓存；SGD train_step 不读 q，因此 q 内存只在消费者访问后出现。
没有多形状曲线、GPU/WASM 读数或实验录像；SGD/forward/with_grad/Adam 都不再 pack，pack() 仅公开参考。
浏览器 playground/WASM 不能执行该内核；前端只消费静态快照。

provenance.note: --mtrits 只控制位平面 ALU 基准；反向/训练步形状由 --rows/--cols 决定。
